EXISTING_UPDATER=$HOME/Library/Application Support/NOVA ERA/SUPRA Updater/supra_autobuild_self_update.sh
EXISTING_MISSION=$HOME/NOVA_OS/SUPRA_GRANDE_MISSION_V1

DO NOW:
1) Verify REQUIRED_APP_HEAD CI SUCCESS.
2) Run only the EXISTING updater immediately. No new updater/bridge/runtime.
3) Require installed app contains REQUIRED_APP_HEAD or a descendant containing it; preserve rollback.
4) Prove current local ownership before any retirement:
   - SUPRA PID, executable path, bundle id, visible windows, TCP endpoints.
   - SUPRAClean PID(s), executable path, cwd, bundle id, visible windows, TCP endpoints.
   - Determine whether SUPRAClean owns/shared 127.0.0.1:18765 or 127.0.0.1:4096, or merely consumes the same endpoints.
   - Determine whether SUPRAClean is an authoritative runtime, an auxiliary UI surface, or independent.
5) DO NOT kill SUPRAClean unless evidence proves it is a redundant non-authoritative legacy surface and canonical SUPRA already contains its required capabilities. If unproven, keep it alive and report exact missing proof.
6) Confirm Process Observatory now reports historical failures as HISTORICAL and live pulse as CLEAR when in_flight=0, bottlenecks=0, drift=0.
7) Resume the EXISTING Grande Mission from first non-PASS canonical phase; preserve PASS 01..07. Continue 08→09→10 under current bounded self-recovery rules.
8) Stop only on explicit HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED=YES or irreversible/security/money/legal/publication authority gate.
9) Publish SUPRA_LOCAL_RUNTIME_PROOF.json to existing Drive STATE and include:
   installed_source_sha, observed_canonical_sha, SUPRA process/window/bundle/TCP, SUPRAClean process/window/bundle/cwd/TCP, ownership verdict, current Grande Mission phase/status.
10) ACTION_NICOLAS=NONE unless a true human-only gate remains.

NO_NEW_ENGINE=YES

NO_DESTRUCTIVE_DELETE=YES
NO_BLIND_KILL=YES
